rules.story: SIZE: frac(r1x) >= 0.5 x frac(sdir) and r1x - pooled A > 0 (CI excluding 0) -> 'the sw016 null was about size: d_self moves story characters at story-native dose'. DIRECTION: frac(r1x) <= 0.15 x frac(sdir), or r1x does not beat pooled A -> 'direction matters: stories do not read d_self even at sdir's dose'. INTERMEDIATE otherwise.
rules.chat: 'the story direction's chat effect survives equal-size controls' if rstory_x - pooled A > 0 with CI excluding 0 and pooled A |shift| <= 0.15; otherwise 'not specific at equal size'. Induce and remove are read separately.
